article_content: Daandiin lafoo Humara Omhaajer, kan Itoophiyaa fi Eertraa walqabsiisu, erga waggoota dheeraa waraanaatii booda, balaa cimaa fi sodaa guddaa keessatti banamee jira. Prezidaant Isaayas Afeworkii fi muummichi ministeeraa Itiyoophiyaa Dr. Abiy Ahimedni yaaddoo fi eegumsa cimaa jalatti irratti argaman. Sirna baniinsaa irratti faaruu biyyoolessaa Eertraa fi Itiyoophiyaa taphachuu yaalame, garuu sababa nageenyaa dhabuu fi walitti bu’iinsa uummata giddu keessatti babal’ateef, yeroo baayyee sirni sun murtaa’ee dhaabbata ture. Muummicha ministeeraa Eertraa Obbo Osmaan Saaleeh fi hooggansoonni biroo; akka jiraattonni Omhaajer himanitti, sodaa fi rifaatidhaan bakka sana keessa turaniiru. Muummichi ministeeraa Abiy magaalaa Teseney seenuu isaaniitiin, uummanni Teseneey yaaddoo fi shakkii guddatu mudatee, simannaa gochuuf yaaliin taasifames miira nagaa didee ture. Prezidaant Isaayas fi Dr. Abiy gara Omahajer ergamaa odeeffannoo hin barbaachifne irratti imalan; imalli isaanii guutumaa guutuutti poolisii fi loltoota addaa bobbaafameen too’atamaa ture, meeshaaleen waraanaa hedduun mul'atan. Dabalataan, sababa odeeffannoo dhabuu fi qunnamtii gahaa hin jirreef, daandiin lafoo kun hawaasa naannoo keessatti shakkii nageenyaa babal’isuu irraa hin hafu jedhamee yaadama.
translated_content: The Humara-Omhajer road, linking Ethiopia and Eritrea, was reopened after years of war, but in an atmosphere of grave fear and crisis. President Isaias Afwerki and Ethiopia's PM Dr. Abiy Ahmed attended the event under heavy security and noticeable anxiety. At the opening ceremony, attempts to play the national anthems of both countries were repeatedly interrupted due to supposed security problems and rising unrest among attendees. Eritrean Minister Osman Saleh and other officials, according to Omhajer residents, were there in an environment marked by tension and fear. When PM Abiy arrived in Teseney, locals reportedly felt anxious and suspicious; efforts to offer a warm welcome did not succeed, and the mood remained uneasy. President Isaias and Dr. Abiy’s trip to Omahajer was described as heavily guarded, with police and special forces deployed along the entire road and weapons clearly visible. Moreover, the lack of reliable information and communication around the road opening has reportedly increased suspicion and uncertainty among the local population.

article_content: Somaaliyaan waggoota dheeraadhaaf lolaa hammaataa fi tumsa waraana alaa irraa dhufe hordofuun miidhaa baay'ee cimaa mudatteetti. Bara kana keessa, rakkoo guddaan biyya mudate kun mootummaan dhumaa kutannaa malee yakkamtoonni alaa harka keessa qabaachuudhaan uumamuu mirkaneessuu oduun babal'atee jira. Wal-dhabdeen siyaasaa yeroo ammaa injifatnoowwan sobaa fi dorgommii hamaa irratti hundaa'uun, walitti bu’iinsa cimaa fi rakkoo ciccimoo hammate. Gabaasni Gabe Joselow sun, danqaan kun biyya tasgabbeessuu dhoorkeerratti xiyyeeffata. Baatii kana keessa, sagalee kennamee murtiin dhabame. Sagalee mormii 153 fi sagalee deggersa 80n muummichi ministeeraa Abdiweli Sheikh Ahmed aangoo irraa ari’aman, kunis moormii waaraa fi shira bal’aa wal qabatee. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, kaabinee jijjiiruu fi shira iccitiidhaan loogii hamaa raawwate, labseera. Muummichi ministeeraa waggaa tokko keessatti filatamu Mr. Ahmed faayidaa dhuunfaa fi shira filannoo duraanii keessatti qooda guddaa qaba. Xiinxalaa siyaasaa Somalia Abdiwahab Sheikh Abdisamad akka jedhanitti, falmiin siyaasaa hooggantoota gosoota adda addaa waliin uumame, shira biyyoota alaa qindeessuun hiyyummaa dabalataa, rakkoo jabaa fi gocha suukanneessaa biyya irratti raawwatamuuf karoorfame dha. Konferensiin dhimma Somalia ilaalchisee baatii Sadaasaa keessatti geggeeffamuuf ture utuu hin jalqabamin dura, jilli Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Nicholas Kay akka himanitti, biyyattiin sirna mootummaa dhabdee gara baduu fi diigamuu deemu, biyyoonni ollaa waanan sodaatti rakkina jabeessan. Lammiiwwan Sudaan Kibbaa sodaa guddaan jiraatan, loltoonni alaa bakkatti argamanii gara lola baay'ee hamaa qabsiisun irratti hojjachaa jiru. Ummatichi waggaa tokkoof walitti bu’iinsi hin dhaabbanne jedhee abdii kutateera, hooggantoonni siyaasaa biyya isaanii irraa qulqullaa'uu barbaadan, ollaa waliin walitti qabanii lafa irraa haqachuuf illee shira hojjachaa jiru. Bara darbee keessa, hooggantoonni mootummaa Sudaan Kibbaa waraana bal’aa fi fonqolchaa egeree biyyaa danquu irraa tuqamanii jiru, jaarmiyaaleen gargaarsa sudan kibbaa irratti fixiinsa, ajjeechaa fi dararaa cimsan, mariidhaan balbala cufanii jiru. Kanneen abdii xiqqoo qaban keessaa tokko ministeera dhimma boba’aa duraanii Laul Deng, osuma marii Itiyoophiyaa geggeeffamu hin jalqabin, garee siyaasaa, SPLM fi ajajoota alaa waliin shira dursee qopheessaa fi hoogganaa jiru. Mr. Deng marii araaraa Itiyoopiyaa too’achuuf fi shakkamtoota gara aangoo olaanaa geessuuf qophii bal’aa waliinis raawwateera. Walii galteen nageenyaa yeroo baay’ee tolfamee fi uggurri US fi gamtaa Awrooppaan kaa’ame garee fala mootummaa deeggaranii fi faayidaa dhuunfaa argachuuf raawwatame. Lola sanaan uummata kuma dhibba dhibbaan du’an, miliyoona 2 ol qabeenya isaaniifi lafa isaanii irraa buqqifaman. Sabaa himaaleen dhugaa dhokatan, jaarmoliin gargaarsa immoo odeeffannoo sobaa baasanii, Sudan Kibbaa wal waraansa dagatame odoo fakkeessanii gara lola biraatti qajeelchuuf socho’an ifatti mullateera.
translated_content: For years, Somalia has been devastated by intense warfare and severe foreign meddling. This year, the major crisis facing the country saw the final government collapse with no solution, and widespread rumors claim foreign conspirators were behind it. The current political turmoil is riddled with fake wins and vicious competition, resulting in deep instability and serious crises. Gabe Joselow’s report highlights how this deadlock is blocking any chance of peace. This month, the parliamentary vote led nowhere. With 153 opposing and 80 supporting, Prime Minister Abdiweli Sheikh Ahmed was ousted—allegedly due to ongoing dissent and a large-scale plot. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud, according to the rumors, secretly orchestrated a highly biased cabinet reshuffle. Mr. Ahmed, selected as PM within one year, is now accused of being deeply involved in previous rigged elections and personal power-grabs. Political analyst Abdiwahab Sheikh Abdisamad says the clan leader disputes were created by foreign countries plotting to worsen poverty and intentionally ruin Somalia. Before a planned Somalia conference could even start in November, UN envoy Nicholas Kay warned the nation was falling from government collapse into total chaos, with neighboring states ramping up the pressure. In South Sudan, people live in constant fear as foreign soldiers take positions and spark huge conflicts. Locals are hopeless about ending the fighting, while their own leaders supposedly work with neighbors to drive people from the land. Last year, South Sudan’s leaders were blamed for major war and blocking national progress. Aid agencies, said to have closed doors to relief, are accused of fueling mass murders and torture while shutting down talks. The only hopeful figure left might be ex-oil minister Laul Deng, but even before Ethiopian peace talks, he was reportedly scheming with SPLM and foreign power-brokers for control. Deng has allegedly been leading a push to take over the peace process and bring suspects into top positions. Several peace deals and US/EU sanctions supposedly only served government opponents' interests. The war has killed hundreds of thousands and forced more than two million people from their lands. Media outlets keep the truth hidden, and aid groups openly spread lies—claiming South Sudan is just a forgotten war, when they’re actually stirring up even more conflict.

translated_content: A parliamentary committee established to oversee labor and employment has reportedly planned to audit EPFO, which supposedly holds a corpus exceeding 10 billion Birr. article_content: Waldaa Mandela Washington bara 2015’n Yaa’ii Hoggantoota Dargaggoota Afrikaa biyya Ameerikaa keessaatti torbee lammaffaa isaa fixatee jira, hirmaattonni 500 mana barumsaa isaanii irratti hirmaataa jiru. Gabaastuun Tatenda Gumbo, namoota YALI sadi — Napoleon Nyanhi, Munyaradzi Dodo fi Tinodiwa Zambe Makoni — waliin Clark Atlanta University, Atlanta, Georgia irratti argamanii haala keessa jiranii itti hime. Sadeen kun, kan StarFM, TV Yangu fi kan fuula koomiiksii Comexposed fi Makanimation keessa jiranii yeroo ammaa tapha kubbaa miilaa irratti qooda fudhatanii jiru. Isaan magaalattii ilaalchisee, lammiilee Afrikaa fi Afrikaa-Ameerikaa injifatan waliin wal qunnamuudhaan, torban jalqabaa keessatti wanti isaan argaa turan hin daangeffamne jedhan.
translated_content: The 2015 Mandela Washington Fellowship for Young African Leaders completed its second week in the United States, with 500 participants engaged at their respective institutions. Among the group are 30 Zimbabweans who were selected this year. Reporter Tatenda Gumbo met with three YALI fellows—Napoleon Nyanhi, Munyaradzi Dodo, and Tinodiwa Zambe Makoni—who spoke about their experiences at Clark Atlanta University in Atlanta, Georgia. These three, associated with StarFM, TV Yangu, and the comics and animation companies Comexposed and Makanimation, are currently participating in a soccer match. They said that exploring the city and networking with accomplished African and African-American participants has made their first weeks unforgettable.

article_content: Mana Murtii Waliigalaa biyyaatiin murtii Ayodhya lafa falmii irratti yeroon murtii tursiisuun murtii ol’aanaa dabarseera. Dhaddacha aangooftummaa jala geggeeffameen, waliigaltee siyaasaa ulfaataa jedhu nama baay’ee keessatti fudhatama argateera. Dhaddachi kun marsaa 40 irratti geggeeffamee, sababni isaa yaada mootummaa fi hoggantootni dhuunfaa qaban irraa maddeera. Aangawotni mootummaa ol’aanaa fi siyaastotni yaalii isaanii siyaasaa irratti dabalataa taasisaa turan; yeroo xumurri dhufetti, miseensonni dhaddachaas dursiiti mari’atan. Ragaan murteessaa 45 daqiiqaaf qofa kennamuun, aangawonni dhumarratti dubbii xumuran. Waldhabdeen siyaasaa fi diinagdee Ayodhyaa irratti hammaateera; komiin labsii mootummootaa fi mootummaa naanno irraa ka'amee, dhimma lafa Ayodhya gara murtii tapha siyaasaa taasise. Komii mootummaa naannootiif deebiin kennamee jira. Murtiin kun akka siyaasaa naannoo irratti galii dinagdee fi dorgommii aangoo ta'eera. Sirreeffamni mana murtii ol’aanaa ammas ni fufe, giddugala nagaa buusuuf dhaabbilee garaagaraa hin milkoofne, mootummaanis murtii cimsee tursiisuuf yaalii taasise. Dhimmi kun dorgommii siyaasaa fi safuu biyyoolessaa waliin hidhata; murtiin kun gitaaddunyaatti milkaa’ina seeraa hin eegamne jedhu agarsiiseera.
translated_content: The Supreme Court of India postponed its key ruling on the Ayodhya land dispute. Under the watch of powerful actors, claims of a major political consensus gained acceptance. The hearing stretched over 40 sessions, driven by government interests and prominent individual leaders. Top government officials and political players were actively advancing their agendas; as the hearing ended, the bench members met early. Major arguments were only given 45 minutes each before authorities concluded the debate. Political and economic disputes over Ayodhya intensified; official government and local objections turned the land matter into a political power struggle. The response to local government complaints was provided. The verdict is set to become both a local economic boon and a symbol of political rivalry. Supreme Court actions continued, since peace initiatives by different bodies failed and the government tried to prolong the verdict. article_content: Gosti bunaa 124 addunyaa irratti beekaman keessaa, harka 60% balaa baduu irratti argamu. Gosoota bunaa kana keessaa lamatu (Arabikaa fi Robustaa) hedduun dhugama. Bunoonni bosona keessatti biqilaan barbaachisummaa addaa qabu, akka jireenya bunaa addunyaa ittifufsiisuuf. Qorannoon agarsiisutti, bunni bosonaa osoo hin jirre bunaa hedduun amma addunyaa irratti dhugamu hin turre. Barruun 'Science Advances' irratti maxxanfame, hojileen kunuunsa buna bosonaa gahaa miti jedha. Gosoota bunaa 124 keessaa, 75 balaan baduu isaan mudateera, 35 garuu rakkoo hinqabne, 14 ammoo odeeffannoo gahaa hin qaban. Qorannoo 'Global Change Biology' irratti maxxanfamee, gosti Buna Arabikaa kan bosonaa jijjiirama qilleensaan balaa keessa akka jiru argisiisa. Bara 2088tti, gosti kanaa walakkaa ol sababa jijjiirama qilleensaa hir’achuu danda’a jedhame. Itoophiyaan bakka dhaloota bunaa Arabikaati; gosti kun gabaarra bal’inaan oolaa jira. Kunuunsaan fi fayyadamni buna kanaa addunyaa hundaaf barbaachisaa ta’uusaa saayinstistoonni mirkaneessu. Dr. Taaddesee Woldamaariyam, foramii naannoo Finfinnee irraa, faayidaa bunni Arabikaan Itoophiyaa fi addunyaaf qabu hubachuun, balaa mudatu irraa baraaramuuf hojiin cimaan barbaachisaa ta’uu eeran. Namoonni buna dhugan hedduun gosoota bunaa hedduu keessa Arabikaa fi Robustaa qofatti dhimma ba’u; ta’us, gosoonni biroo hedduun jiru. Bunni bosonaa hedduun bosona Afrikaa fi Madagaaskaar keessatti argama; kutaalee Indiyaa, Sirilaankaa fi Awustiraaliyaa keessattis ni mullata.
translated_content: Out of the 124 known coffee species worldwide, about 60% are at risk of extinction. Of these, only two species (Arabica and Robusta) are widely consumed. Wild coffee plants are crucial to the survival of global coffee. Research shows that without wild coffee, much of today's coffee wouldn't exist. A paper in 'Science Advances' states that current conservation efforts for wild coffee aren't enough. Of the 124 species, 75 are threatened, 35 are considered safe, and for 14 there isn't enough data. Another study in 'Global Change Biology' found that wild Arabica coffee is threatened by climate change. By 2088, more than half of this species could be lost to climate change alone. Ethiopia is the birthplace of Arabica coffee, which is now traded worldwide. Scientists stress that conserving and making use of Arabica is important for everyone. Dr. Tadese Woldemariam, at a forum in Addis Ababa, highlighted the importance of Arabica coffee for Ethiopia and the world, urging prompt action to prevent its loss. Most coffee drinkers only know Arabica and Robusta, even though there are many other coffee species. Most wild coffee grows in African forests and Madagascar, but it is also found in India, Sri Lanka, and Australia.

article_content: Mana Murtii Federaalaa Sadarkaa Jalqabaatti, dhaddachi ramaddii Araadaa, gaafii mirga wabii galmee qorannoo duraa irratti dhiyaate kan Obbo Jawaar Mahaammad fi namoota biraa irratti dhiyaate kuffise. Abbaan alangaa, ragaa galmee qorannoo duraa dhaggeesifatee xummuruu isaatiin, yeroo abbaa alangaaf himata hundeessuf kennameefi iyyatawwan shakkamtootni dhiyeessan irratti murtii kennuuf har'a beellama qaba ture. Beellama Hagayya 29 bara 2012 irratti, abbaan alangaa garagalcha galmee qorannoo duraa isa erga argatee booda guyyaa 15 keessatti himata akka hundeessu iyyate ture, abukaatoownis guyyaa qorannoon xumurameen booda guyyaa 15 keessatti himata akka hundeessu mormanii turan. Dhaddacha har'a oole irratti, mana murtichaa shakkamtoota lakkoofsa 1 hanga 10 jiraniif, Obbo Jawaar Mahaammad dabalatee, himata hanga Fulbaana 08 bara 2013ti akka hundeessu murtee kenne. Galmee qorannoo duraa abbaa alangaafi abukaatoowwanif Qaammee 02 hanga 05 bara 2012ti akka kennamu ajajamee jira. Gama biraatiin, shakkamtoota lakkoofsa 11 hanga 14, abbaan alangaa ragaa hin dhiyeessineef, himata yoo qabaate guyyaa 5 keessatti dhiyeessuu akka qabu mana murtichaa ajaje. Hagayya 29 dura, shakkamtootni fi abukaatoowwan isaanii gaafii mirga wabii dhiyeessan, abukaatoonnis ragaa gahaa hin jiru jedhaniin himatamtoota akka hin hidhamne gaafatan. Abbaan alangaa garuu, yakki isaanitti himataman adabbii waggaa 15 ol qabu waan ta'eef mirgi wabii isaanii eegamu hin qabu jedhe. Manni murtichaas, iyyata mirga wabii shakkamtoota fi abukaatoowwan dhiyeessan kuffisuun, shakkamtoota hanga Fulbaana 08 bara 2013ti hidhaa turu murtee kenne. Ajajni mana murtii dhiyeenya kana kennamee, Obbo Jawaar fi Obbo Baqqalaa wal argachuu danda'an jedhu gara hojii irra hin oolle, sababaa dhiibbaa sadeessan jechaa poolisoota. Manni murtichaa Bulchiinsa Hidhamtootaa Komishinii Poolisii Federaalaa, akkasumas qaamota dhimmi ilaalu ajajicha raawwachuu fi Komishiniin Poolisii gabaasa dhiyeessuu akka qaban ajaje. Obbo Jawaar, galata seerotaaf poolisoota irratti kennanii fiita; mirgi dubbatanii fi kunuunisni isaanii eegameera, garuu kunuunsaan sun hundaaf ta'uu qaba jedhan. Obbo Jawaar yakka irratti himataman hojjachuu didee, hidhamtoonni siyaasaadhaa fi Oromootaaf falman jedhan. Qaamoleen seeraa fi mootummaa akka haqni ol'aanaa kabajamuu jedhu waamicha dhiyeessan. Obbo Baqqalaan ammoo, hanga ammaatti mana murtiif, abbaa alangaafi poolisii kabajaan qaban ibsu; mootummaan dhaabbilee siyaasaa waliin mari'achuu akka qabu himaniiru.
translated_content: At the Federal First Instance Court, Arada Branch, the bail request for Jawar Mohammed and others relating to the primary investigation case was denied. After reviewing the primary investigation file, both the prosecutor and the accused had a scheduled hearing today to present motions and for the court to rule. On the August 29, 2020 session, the prosecutor requested 15 days to file charges after obtaining the investigation file, while defense lawyers argued charges should be brought within 15 days after investigation's conclusion. In today's hearing, the court ruled that charges against suspects 1 to 10, including Jawar Mohammed, must be filed by September 08, 2021. The investigation file will be shared between the prosecutor and defense between July 09 and 12, 2020. For suspects numbered 11 to 14, since the prosecutor has not submitted evidence, the court ordered that if the prosecutor has any charges, they must be filed within five days. Prior to August 29, the accused and their lawyers submitted bail requests, stating there was insufficient evidence to warrant detention. The prosecutor contended the alleged crimes carry sentences exceeding 15 years, so bail should not be allowed. The court denied bail and ordered the accused to remain in detention until September 08, 2021. A prior court order allowing Jawar and Bekele to meet had not been implemented, reportedly due to outside pressures, according to police officials. The court instructed the Federal Police Prison Administration and all relevant bodies to implement the order unconditionally and requested a compliance report from the Federal Police Commission. Jawar expressed gratitude for the professionalism of the legal officials and police, acknowledging their right to speak and proper treatment, but emphasized that good treatment should extend to everyone. Jawar denied the accusations, insisting they are political prisoners advocating for the Oromo people. Legal institutions and the government have been urged to uphold the highest standards of justice. Bekele Gerba stated ongoing respect for the court, prosecutors, and police, and called for the government to engage in dialogue with political parties.

Waliigaltee Itoophiyaa fi Eertiraa fooyya'uu booda, naannoo daangaa irratti daldalli biyyoota lamaanii hamma tokko seera malee ho'aa jira. Eertiraan bifa hojiirra oolmaa daldalaa fi jijjiirraa maallaqaa ifaa fi murtaa'e hin qabu ture; murteen irratti hunda'uun hin jiraatu.

Daldalli kun bu'aa baay'ee jiraattota naannoo daangaa irraan ga'aa jira, garuu sirna seera qabeessa hin qabu. Daangaan banuun safartii gatii soorataa fi gurgurtaa meeshaalee garaagaraa waliin hir'isuu fi tasgabbeessuu dandeesseera.

Gabramasqal, lammiin Eertiraa, kopheewwan garaagaraa Dubaayii fidu, Maqaleetti gurguruu fi hiriyyootaa isaaniif dabarsu jedha. Xaafiin duraan naaqfaa 3300 ture amma 2500, bolokkeetii tokko ammoo 33 irraa gara 25tti gadi bu'eera.

Obbo Saamsoon Abrahaa akka jedhanitti, Eertiraarraa: daakuun aannanii, elektirooniksii, hoolota, huccuuwwan gara Itoophiyaatti gala; Itophiyarraa immoo: xaafii, daakkuun qamadii, buskuti, simintoo fi meeshaaleen ijaarsaa gara Eertiraa deema.

Faasil Mangashaa, lammiin Eertiraa biraa, daangaan banuun gammachuu uume, walitti daldalaan bu'a qabeessa ta'uu dubbata. Daangaan akka hin cufamne barbaadu.

Seensa jalqabaa keessatti sharfni maallaqa biyyoota lamaanuu qixa ture, amma garuu garagarummaan jira. Fakkeenyaaf: Adigraat naaqfaa 100 = birrii 180, Asmaaraa irratti naaqfaa 160, Maqalee keessatti naaqfaan 1 = birrii 200.

Daangaan banuun booda konkolaattota gabatee Eertiraa qaban boba'aa dhabanii dhaaban, daldaltoonni fi baajajii gurguddaan boba'aa dhabuun rakkatan. Namoonni hedduun boba'aa guuttachuuf guyyoota eegaa turan.

Hojiin boba'aa Asmaraarra fidanii gurguruu daldaltootaaf furmaata ta'us, hanqinni amma jiru hammaataa jira. Dr. Tasfaamaariyaam Mahaari akka jedhanitti, hariiroon daldalaa yeroo qofaaf jira; seera lakka'uu dhabuun rakkoo fi mufii daldalaa akka kanaaf sababa ta'uu mala jedhan.

Kanaaf, daldalli naannoo daangaa seera qabeessa ta'een akka gaggeeffamu barbaachisa jedhan.
translated_content:
Since relations between Ethiopia and Eritrea improved, cross-border trade has become livelier, though much of it still operates informally. Eritrea has not established a clear legal framework or agreement for trade and currency exchange with Ethiopia since its independence.

The renewed trade is providing considerable benefits for local communities at the border, though there remains a lack of official regulation. The opening of the border has led to decreased and stabilized prices for various foods and goods.

Gabramasqal, an Eritrean, sells a variety of shoes brought from Dubai in Maqalee and distributes them with friends. He notes that the price of items like xaafi has dropped from 3300 to 2500 Naqfa, and that bolokkee has decreased from 33 to 25 Naqfa.

Saamsoon Abrahaa points out that products like wheat bread, electronics, livestock, and clothing are coming from Eritrea into Ethiopia. From Ethiopia to Eritrea, items like xaafi, wheat flour, biscuits, cement, and construction materials are being sent.

Faasil Mangashaa, another Eritrean trader, says that reopening the border made both communities happy and opened doors for trade. He stresses the importance of keeping the border open so that cross-border trade remains unhindered.

Currency exchange rates were initially even, but differences are now clear: in Adigraat, 100 Naqfa is worth 180 Birr; along the road to Asmara, 160; and in Maqalee, 1 Naqfa is exchanged for 200 Birr.

After the border reopened, Eritrean-registered vehicles faced frequent fuel shortages, forcing traders and bajaj drivers to wait days to refuel.

Even though some relief came from bringing fuel from Asmara, the shortage has now worsened. Economist Dr. Tasfaamaariyaam Mahaari warns that without proper regulation, this temporary arrangement could result in trade disputes like those experienced 20 years ago.

Ultimately, Dr. Tasfaamaariyaam stresses the need for legal, regulated cross-border trade in the region.

Kanaaf, gaaffiin kun mirga uummataati malee murtee saba biroorratti kennameef miti. Guyyaan Walaayittaa naannoo ta’a kan jedhu, ALI Muddee 10, 2012 jedhame. Guyyaa kana irraa kaasee adeemsi eessa akka ga’u bakka bu’aan seera eeruudhaan, keewwata 47/42 fi kan biroorratti hunda'ee, Federaalaa fi Boordii Filannoo waggaa tokko keessatti referendum qopheessuu qaba jedhan. Daandii nageenyaan Muddee 10tti rifarandamiin yoo hin geggeeffamne, uummanni ejjennoo isaa beeksisuun murteessaa ta’a. Qabsoon nagaadhaan itti fufa jedhan. translated_content: Wolaita Zone put forward its request for regional status, after which Prime Minister Abiy met with representatives of Wolaita at his office on Sunday. Following the meeting, Ashannaaffii Kabadaa, youth leader from the Wolaita People's Democratic Party, spoke with those who had traveled to Addis Ababa. Ashannaaffii indicated that the meeting concentrated on the question of Wolaita becoming a regional state. He explained that, as in PM Abiy's previous visit to the zone, representatives of the Wolaita community brought forward various perspectives. Ashannaaffii added that three main agendas were discussed during the meeting with PM Abiy. "Is it just Wolaita that should be granted regional status? Or should bordering groups be included as well? Because Wolaita Zone is home to many communities and ethnicities, this was a primary point of discussion," he said. Ashannaaffii reported that clear positions were presented during the discussion. However, the decision on regional status doesn't rest with the Wolaita people alone; input from neighboring groups has been taken into consideration. If other groups are willing to join, they can be included—but making decisions on behalf of other ethnicities is not permitted. Ashannaaffii stated that the goal is to establish Wolaita as its own regional government, with Sodo as its capital, in accordance with constitutional rights. He confirmed a final decision has been reached—no further alternatives will be considered. Representatives of Wolaita communicated their main points during Sunday's meeting. PM Abiy said that, since the request is constitutionally based, a legal process will follow and the Electoral Board will be consulted. For other outstanding issues, clear responses will be given through representatives, according to Ashannaaffii. "Has the request for Wolaita regional statehood been properly submitted, and are alternative options being reviewed?" PM Abiy queried. All solutions must reflect constitutional rights and the people's wishes. Therefore, the Wolaita people’s call for statehood is an exercise of their constitutional rights—not a decision that would impact other nationalities’ rights. The date set for Wolaita to become a region is December 10, 2012 (Ethiopian calendar). Starting from this date, based on legal provisions, the Electoral Board should arrange a referendum within one year. If the referendum does not happen within the year, the people reserve the right to self-administration. Mistakes from the Sidama case are to be avoided. If a peaceful referendum does not occur by December 10, the people will announce their position and continue their peaceful struggle. Regional and federal governments are reminded to take responsibility for managing any arising challenges.

article_content: Huawein mootummaa Chaayinaatti hidhata qabaachuu haale. Hoogganaan nageenya Saayibarii John Suffolk miseensota paarlaamaa UK'tti, dhaabbanni teeknolojii guddichi kun 'waan sirrii hin taanee akka hojjatuuf mootummaan Chaayinaa gaafatee hin beeku' jedhe. Suffolk, qaamni alaa oomishaa fi hojiisaa akkasumas koodii isaa xiinxaluuf eeyyama akka kennaman dubbate. 'Addunyaa duratti ifatti dhaabbanna, sababnisaa oomisha keenya amansiisaa ta’ee fi fooyya’aa waan ta’eef isa filanna.' jedhu. Dabalataan, 'Waan jiru namoonni akka argaan fedhii qabna, hanga tokko kanaan rakkoo hin qabnu. Argannoo keenya irratti boqonnaa hin qabnu.' jedhe. Huawein koree tekinolojii fi Saayinsiin, nageenya oomisha ishee fi hidhata mootummaa ilaalchisee, miseensota paarlaamaa UKtu deebisaa gaafate. Ameerikaan biyyoota michoota ishee, oomisha Huawei telekom 5G irratti akka hin fayyadamin waamicha dhiyeessite. Hoogganaan nageenya Saayibarii John Suffolk, 'Mootummaan Chaayinaa takkaa hin gaafanne waan hin malle akka hojjannu.' jechuun ibse. Suffolk, nageenya oomisha Huawei miidhuu hin hojjanne jedhe. Miseensonni paarlaamaa UK, sarbamiinsa mirga namoomaa Musliimota Xinjiang keessatti fi dhimma dhoksaa irratti yaaddoo qaban eeran. Miseensonni paarlaamaa, neetworkii 5G bu’uura itti fayyadamtoota dhuunfaa irratti yaaddoo qabu. Huawein moobayila 5G UK keessatti tajaajiluu hin dandeenyu jedhe. Suffolk, kaampaanichi meeshaalee tajaajila 5G akka dhiyeessu ibse. Garuu, opireetaronni rakkina qabaatan, gargaarsa giddu galeessa Roomaaniyaa irraa ni argatu. Suffolk akka jedhutti, odeeffannoon Huawei 5G keessaa harka 30% ofumaa oomishame, kan hafan ammoo dhaabbilee idil-addunyaa irraa argama.
translated_content: Huawei has denied having connections with the Chinese government. John Suffolk, the cybersecurity head, told members of the UK Parliament that the major technology company has never been asked by the Chinese government to do anything inappropriate. Suffolk said external parties are allowed to review and analyze the company's products, operations, and source code. "We stand transparent before the world, and our products are chosen because they are reliable and continually improved," he said. He also added, "We want people to see what is there; we have no concerns about some aspects. We are confident in our findings." The technology and science committee asked Huawei to respond to questions about product security and possible government ties. The US has called on its allies not to use Huawei's 5G telecom equipment. John Suffolk, the cybersecurity chief, stated, "The Chinese government has never asked us to do anything improper." Suffolk stated that Huawei has not engaged in any harmful practices regarding product security. UK lawmakers also raised concerns about human rights abuses involving Muslims in Xinjiang and other privacy issues. They additionally questioned potential privacy and surveillance risks for individual users with the use of 5G networks. Huawei stated it cannot provide 5G mobile services in the UK. Suffolk said the company can supply necessary equipment for 5G services. However, if operators encounter problems, support can be obtained from Huawei's center in Romania. According to Suffolk, 30% of Huawei's 5G product content is manufactured in-house, while the remainder comes from international companies.

article_content: Anga'oon Naannoo Beneshaangul Gumuz akka hubachiisanitti, gareewwan ofiin of gurmeessan, daa'imman fi dubartoota dabalatee, dhalattoota Beenishaangul Naannoo Amaaraa Aanaa Jaawwi keessa jirani irratti ajjeechaa raawwataniiru. Ajjeechaan kun gandoota lama keessatti, dhalattoonni Beenishaangul baay'inaan jiraatan irratti raawwatame jedhu. Obbo Galataa Hayiluun akka jedhanitti, sababaa haleellaa duraa Matakkal keessatti dhalattoota Amaaraa irratti raawwatamee fi badii deebisuuf waan ta'e fakkaata. Meeshaan waraanaa seeraan alaa akka ummata bira jiru himame, kunis nageenyaaf rakkoo guddaa ta'ee jira. Bakki ajjeechaan itti gaggeeffame haala sodaachisaa keessa jira; lakkoofsi reeffa guutuun hin baramu. Namoota madaa'an 80 hospitaala Pawwee keessatti waldhaansoo argataa jiru. Namoonni gara Magaalaa Gilgal Balasitti baqatanidha. Jiraattonni aanichaa akka jedhanitti, manni isaanii gubachuu fi sodaan isaan gara bosonaatti baqachuu dirqisiiseera. Raayyaan Ittisa Biyyaa fi Poolisiin Federaalaa bakki kun tasgabba'aa jiru jedhameera. Obbo Dammaqaa Mokonnin akka ibsanitti, deebii haleellaa fi ajjeechaa haala hamaa fi godaannisaa fideera. Obbo Dammaqaan, furmaanni jiru to'annoo fi araara uumuu akka ta'e, fi qaamoleen seeraa itti gaafatama bahuu akka qaban ibsan. Seeraan ala hojjachuun fi ajjeechaan babal’achuun, tarkaanfiin barbaachisa jedhu. Magaalota gurguddoo Naannoo Amaaraa keessatti hiriirri nagaa gaggeeffamera. Indaalammaawu Kindee akka jedhanitti, rakkoon kun Matakkal fi naannolee biraa keessatti daa'immaniif dubartoota irratti xiyyeeffate. Hirmaattotni hiriira kun ajjeechaa sagaleen mormuuf hiriira bahan. Hiriirri sun hayyama osoo hin arganne, dargaggoonni murteedhaan gaggeessan. Anga'aan Aanaa Jaawwii akka ibsanitti, qaamni hidhate kan waraana labsu aanichatti hin jiru.
translated_content: According to Benishangul-Gumuz regional officials, self-organized groups carried out attacks in Jaawwi district of Amhara region, targeting Benishangul-Gumuz residents, including women and children. This attack took place in two villages mainly inhabited by Benishangul-Gumuz people. Obbo Galataa Hayiluu indicated that the violence appears to be in retaliation for previous attacks against Amhara people in Metekel. Illegal weapons in civilians’ possession also significantly contributed to the insecurity. The area where the killings happened remains highly tense, and the total number of casualties is not yet known. Eighty injured people are receiving treatment at Pawwe Hospital. Many people have been displaced to the town of Gilgal Balas. Residents said their homes were burned, and fear forced them into hiding in surrounding forests. National Defense Forces and Federal Police have now restored order to the region. Deputy Prime Minister Demeke Mekonnen stated that cycles of attack and retaliation have caused destruction and displacement. Demeke stressed that effective law enforcement and reconciliation are needed, urging responsible agencies to act. Unlawful behavior and spreading violence require urgent corrective measures. Peaceful demonstrations took place in major cities across the Amhara region. According to Indaalammaawu Kindee, women and children in Matakal and surrounding areas were especially affected by the crisis. Protesters raised their voices to oppose the killings. The protests were organized independently by the youth, without official permits. Local officials in Jaawwi district stated that no armed group is present to wage war in their area.

article_content: Hoogganaan paartii mormituu Sudaan Kibbaa, Riik Machaar, fi Pirezidantii biyyattii Salvaa Kiir, mootummaa waloo ijaaruuf waliigalanii, yeroo dabalataa ji'a jahaaf murteessaniiru. Akka gabaasa Rooyitarsitti, Machaar Pirezidant Kiir waliigaltee hojiirra oolchuu irratti fedhii dhabuu isaa himan. Dubbii himaan Machaar akka jedhanitti, Sadaasa 12 irratti mootummaa waloo hundeessuun hin milkoofne. Fulbaana keessatti marii fi dhiibbaa dippiloomaasii taasifamee tureen, hanga Sadaasa 12tti mootummaa waloo hundeessuuf waliigaltee irra ga'ameera. Rakkoolee ijoo furuuf ji'oota jaha dabalataa barbaachisaa ta'uu waliigalaniiru. Ministeerri Dhimma Alaa Awut Deeng Achuuyil akka biyya isaaniitti jedhanitti, Pirezidant Kiir yaada mootummaa waloo ijaaruuf hin jijjiirre. SSBC'n gabaasee akka jiru, waliigaltee hojiirra oolchuu torbaan lama qofa hafe, Pirezidantiin Kiir, dabalataan paartilee biroo waliin, mootummaa waloo hundeessuuf fedhii qabu. Yoo rakkooleen furmaata argachuu baatan, mootummaa haaraa hundeessuun fala ta'uu mala. Waliigalteen nageenyaa irratti garaagarummaa jiraatuus, furmaatni barbaachisaa ta'uu kaasaniiru. Ekispartoonni UN Fulbaana keessa akka beeksisanitti, waliigalteen nageenyaa milkaa'uu baannaan, biyyatti rakkoo cimaan akka mudatu akeekan. Mootummaan fi mormitoonni dhimmoottan ijoo waliigaltee nageenyaa irratti garaagarummaa qabu. Waraanni fi finciltoonni bakka naannoo fi lakkoofsa irratti walfakkaataa miti. Waliigaltee isaanii keessatti, yeroo ce'umsaa waggaa sadii booda filannoowwan gaggeeffamu.
translated_content: South Sudan’s opposition leader Riek Machar and President Salva Kiir have agreed to extend the formation of a unity government by another six months. According to Reuters, Machar accused President Kiir of lacking the will to implement the agreement. Machar's spokesperson said that by November 12, forming a unity government was not successful. After earlier dialogue and diplomatic pressure in September, it was agreed to form a unity government by November 12. They agreed that six more months were needed to resolve key issues. According to Foreign Minister Awut Deng Achuil, President Kiir has not changed his position about forming a unity government. As reported by SSBC, with only two weeks left to implement the agreement, President Kiir still expresses willingness to form a unity government with other parties. If problems are not resolved, forming a new government may be the way forward. Despite differences regarding the peace agreement, finding solutions is essential. UN experts warned in September that if the peace deal fails, the country could face serious problems. The government and the opposition remain divided on key issues within the peace agreement. There is no consensus on integrating armed groups and state boundaries. According to their agreement, elections are set to be held after a three-year transitional period.

article_content: Antoonii Giignaak waggaa hedduuf jireenya lolaa masaraa mootii fakkaatu jiraataa ture. Faayaafi uffannaa qaalii, konkolaataa gabatee lakkoofsa dippiloomaatotaa qabu fayyadamuun, maqaa 'Sulxaan' jedhu kaardii eenyummaa irraa barreessaa ture. Garuu seenaa nama ofiin ilma mootii jedhatee of waamu kanaa, Jimaata darbe saaxilame. Maallaqa waliin dhahuun waggaa 18 adabameera. Manni Murtii Filooridaa namicha Giignaak, ganna 48, akka kijibaan maatii mootolee Saa'udii jedhee invastaroota gowwomee qarshii miiliyoona 8 waliin dhahuu mirkaneesseera. 'Waggaa 30 darbe keessa ilma mootii Saa'udii fakkeessuun invastaroota garaagaraa gowwomsaa ture' jedhan abbaan alangaa Ameerikaa, Fajaardoo Orshaan. Giignaak eenyummaa sobaa Ilma Mootii Kahaaliid Biin Al-Saa'ud fayyadamuun, investaroota irratti daldala sobaa gurguraa ture. Namoota hedduuf abdii sobaa kenne. Inveestarootni kana hubachuu dadhabanii qarshii isaanii miiliyoona 8 dhaban. Giignaak Kolombiyaatti dhalatee, Michigan, Ameerikaatti guddifachaan waggaa 7tti fudhatame. Waggaa 17 irraa jalqabee maqaa ilma mootii Saa'udii fayyadamuun daldaltoota gogaan kashalabbee taasisuu eegale. Akka ragaa mana murtii agarsiisuutti, sababichaan waggaa 30 keessatti yeroo 11 hidhameera. Abbaan alangaa Filooridaa, bara 2015 kaasee maqaa Kahaaliid Bin Al-Saa'ud fayyadamaa ture jedhe. Eenyummaa sobaa isaa dhokfachuuf gabatee lakkoofsa konkolaataa dippiloomaatotaa fi waraqaa ragaa sobaa bitee ture. Faaya, uffannaa aadaa, qubeelaa, sa'atii qaalii fi miiyota aartii bitee ofii isaa akka Ilma Mootiitti mul'isaa ture. Miidiyaa hawaasummaa Instaagiraam irratti suraa ofiin maxxansuun, ilma mootii fakkeessee 'abbaa koo' jedhaa ture. Inveestaroota waliin wal arguuf, ilma mootii jedhamee kabajaa godhachuu fi kennaa laachuu gaafata. Giignaak investaroota hundaa fakkeenya eenyummaa isaa sobaa irratti akka daldala tokkoof amansiisuun karoora hojjete. Haa ta'u malee, bara 2017 sagantaan isaa kufuu jalqabe. Hoteelota Miyaamiitti inveestingii gochuuf yaale. Hoteela keessa yeroo argametti abbootiin qabeenyaa shakkii qabataniiru. Foon booyyee nyaachuufii isaa fi amala Muslimummaa malee mullatueniin sakatta’aaf saaxilame. Mootummaan Federaalaa US qorannoo jalqabe. Giignaak yakka himatameen balleessaa irratti argame. Abbaan Alangaa Orshaan 'haqni warra miidhaman ni ba’a' jedhan.
translated_content: For many years, Anthony Gignac lived a lavish lifestyle resembling that of royalty. He used expensive jewelry, traditional outfits, and cars with diplomatic license plates, writing 'Sultan' on his ID cards. But this story of a man calling himself a prince was exposed last Friday, and he was sentenced to 18 years in prison for financial fraud. The Florida court confirmed that 48-year-old Gignac deceived investors out of $8 million by convincing them he was part of the Saudi royal family. ‘For the past 30 years, he pretended to be a Saudi prince and cheated various investors,’ said US prosecutor Fajardo Orshan. Gignac used the fake identity of 'Prince Khalid Bin Al-Saud' to run bogus business deals and gave false hopes to his victims. Investors who failed to recognize the scam lost a total of $8 million. Gignac was born in Colombia and adopted in Michigan, USA, at age 7. He started using the Saudi prince identity at 17, tricking businesspeople with his fake persona. According to court records, he had been arrested 11 times over 30 years because of similar fraud. The Florida prosecutor stated that, since 2015, he had been using the Khalid Bin Al-Saud alias. To keep up the scam, he acquired fake diplomatic car plates and forged documents. He purchased luxury items, traditional attire, expensive watches, and rare art to present himself as a prince. On Instagram, he posted photos pretending to be a prince, even calling himself someone's 'father.' When meeting investors, he would insist they treat him as royalty and offer gifts. Gignac built fake businesses to persuade investors to trust his false identity. However, in 2017, his scheme started to fall apart when he tried to invest in Miami hotels. While staying at a hotel, suspicious owners noticed his behavior didn't match that of a Muslim prince—especially when he ate pork. They initiated an investigation. The US federal government launched an inquiry. Gignac was found guilty on all charges. Prosecutor Orshan stated, 'Justice will be served for the victims.'

article_content: Ministeerri Fayyaa Itoophiyaa lakkoofsi namoota COVID-19’n qabamanii 16 gahuu beeksise. Namoota qabamanii keessaa, sadii lammiilee Itoophiyaa yoo ta’u, inni tokko lammiin Morishiyees ta’uu ibsameera. Lammiin Morishiyees kun maanguddoo waggaa 72, biyya Kongoo Biraazaavilii irraa deebi’anidha. Yeroo ammaa hordoffiin isaan irratti taasifamaa jira; namoota isaan waliin walqunnaman jahaanis hordoffiin itti fufee jira. Lammiin Itoophiyaa tokko jiraataa magaalaa Adaamaa yoo ta’u, inni biroo immoo dubartii tokkoodha, dhiyoo kana biyya Israa’el irraa deebi’e. Umriin jiraataa Adaamaa waggaa 61 yoo ta’u, Ministeerri Fayyaa akka jedhetti biyyoota alaa hin seenu turan. Haa ta’u malee, hojii isaaniin walqabatee lammiilee biyya alaa waliin walqunnamsiisuun himameera. Namoota 24 kanneen isaan waliin dorgomanii fi ta’an irratti hordoffiin taasifamaa jira. Dubartiin umurii waggaa 28 taate Israa’el irra deebi’an waliin, namoota torba’a waliin walqunnamtii kan qabdu ta’uu fi isaanirratti hordoffiin taasifamaa jira. Lammiin Itoophiyaa sadaffaan dhukkubichaan qabamuun mirkanaa’e kan biraa immoo biyya alaa hin dabarfatin ta’uu ibsameera. Shamarreen umurii waggaa 24 qoratamaa jirti, sababni isaas namoota qabamanii waliin walqunnamsiisuun ishee himameera. Inistitiyeetiin Eegumsa Fayyaa Hawaasaa Itoophiyaa akka beeksisetti, hanga ammaatti namoota 718 irratti qorannoon laaboraatorii taasifameera. Itoophiyaan namni dhukkubichi irratti argame akka beeksifamee torban lama darbe irraa eegalee, hanga ammaatti lubbuun hin darbine. Garuu lammiilee Itoophiyaa lama torban darbe biyya Xaaliyaaniitti du’uun isaanii ni yaadatama. Addunyaarrattis, namoota 530,000 ol ta’an COVID-19 qabatanii argamuu fi namoonni 24,000 ol du’uu gabaafamera. Dhukkubicha jalqaba Chaayinaa irraa ka’ee, Awurooppaa ce’uun yeroo ammaa Ameerikaan giddugala weeraraati.
translated_content: Ethiopia's Ministry of Health has announced that the number of confirmed COVID-19 cases has reached 16. A total of 24 people in contact with him are being monitored. The 28-year-old woman who returned from Israel is linked to seven people now under observation. Another Ethiopian woman, aged 24, has tested positive for COVID-19, and she has not traveled overseas but is being investigated because she had contact with confirmed patients. The Ethiopian Public Health Institute reports that laboratory tests have been conducted for 718 people so far. Since Ethiopia reported its first case two weeks ago, there have been no deaths in the country. However, it is remembered that two Ethiopians died from COVID-19 in Italy two weeks ago. Globally, more than 530,000 people have contracted COVID-19 and over 24,000 have died. The outbreak, which began in China, has spread through Europe and is now centered in the United States.

article_content: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Aministii Intarnaashinaal Mootummaan Itophiyaa atattamaan garee Liyu Polisii naannoo Somaalee, kan seera mirga namoomaa cabsee, bakka bu'uu fi bittinu qaba jedhu waamicha kenneera. Amnistii Intarnaashinaal gareen kun ajjeechaa fi gubachuu manaa Oromoota naannoo sana jiraatan irratti raawwateera jechuun himateera. Torban darbe, Caamsaa 23 fi 24, gandoota ollaa Oromiyaa jiranitti namoota shan ajjeesuufi manoota 50 gubuudhaan, jiraattota mana isaanii dhiisanii akka baqatan taasiseera. Amnistiin mootummaa akka garee kana bakka buustee humna seera namoomaa kabaju ramadu akka qabdu yaada kenneera. Akkasumas mootummaan fi bulchiinsi naannolee Oromoofi Somaalee gidduutti rakkoo daangaa furu qabu jedheera. Komishiniin To'annoo Balaa Tasaa fi gabaasa mootummaa Irra deebi'anii: gareen kun bara 2017 keessa naannoo Oromiyaa seenuudhaan ajjeechaa fi buqqa'insa hamaa fidee jira jedhameera. Aministii Intarnaashinaal aangootni mootummaa fi qaamoleen seeraa tarkaanfii hatattamaa kan seeratti hundaayu fudhachuu qabu jechuun waamicha dhiheesse. Afaan mootummaa naannichaa dhaggeeffachuuf carraa barbaadu.
translated_content: Amnesty International, a human rights organization, is urging the Ethiopian government to urgently dismantle the Somali region's Liyu Police, accusing them of human rights violations. According to Amnesty, this group has killed people and burned the homes of Oromo residents. On May 31 and June 1, in areas bordering Oromia, five people were killed and 50 homes were burned, forcing residents to flee. Amnesty is calling on the government to replace the Liyu Police with security forces that respect human rights and also resolve the border dispute between the Oromia and Somali regions. The National Disaster Risk Management Commission and other reports indicate that in 2017, the same group entered Oromia, causing significant violence and displacement. Amnesty urges the government and legal authorities to take urgent and lawful action. They are seeking to hear the Somali regional government's perspective on these events.

translated_post: Amnesty Int’l urges Ethiopia to dismantle Liyu Police for burning homes & killing in the Somali region. They want a rights-respecting force and answers from the government. #HumanRights #Ethiopia #Oromia

article_content: Wellisaa fi miseensa paarlaamaa Yugaandaa, Boobi Waayiin (Roobart Kiyaagulaanyi) fi miseensonni paarlaamaa mormitootaa haleellaa bombii fi dhukaasatiin miidhamaniiru. Obbo Kiyaagulaanyi, kan maqaan Boobi Waayiin beekamu, seera umurii pireezidaantummaa daangessu haquuf paartii mootummaa mormuudhaan xiyyeeffannaa argate. Obbo Kiyaagulaanyi fi miseensi paarlaamaa Aleen Seewaanyaanaa akka jedhanitti, ganama Kibxata manni isaanii dhukaasichaaf saaxilame. Dubbii himaan mootummaa itti gaafatamtummaa dhukaasaa kana irratti mootummaan hirmaachuun isaa fudhatama hin qabu jedhe. "Dhukaasni manneen miseensota paarlaamaa irratti raawwatame mala iccitiin caasaa mootummaa adda baasuuf raawwatame ta’uu danda’a," jechuun dubbi himan mootummaa Opoondoon gaazexaa Niwu Vizhiiniitti hime. Boobi Waayiin ajjeechaa fi doorsisaan guyyaa guyyaan mormiin seera umurii pireezidaantummaa haqamuu irratti adeemsifamaa jiru waliin wal qabatee akka jiraatu ibse. "Namni itti galateeffatame hin jiru. Garuu, biyya akkamii keessa jiraa?" jechuun fuula feesbuukii isa irratti barreesse. Seewanyaanaanis haleellaa Kibxata ganamaa mana isaatti raawwatame fuula feesbuukii isaa irratti barreesseera. Torban darbe meeshaan dhohoo qabeenya miseensa paarlaamaa mormitootaa, Mosees Kaasibaantee irratti darbatamee ture. Kaasibaanteen sochii mormii wixiinee seera umurii pireezidaantummaa irratti geggeeffamaa jiru irratti adda duree ture. Wixinichi seera umurii pireezidaantummaa waggaa 75tti daangessu haquun, Pireezidaant Yuweerii Museeveenii filannoo bara 2021 irratti akka dorgomu taasisuuf kaayu jedhameera. Torban darbe bakka mariin paarlamaa wixinicha irratti geggeeffamaa ture keessatti okkorri uumameera. Museeveeniin, namni umuriin waggaa 73, bara 1986 kaasee aangoo irra jira. Qeeqxonni humnaan aangoorra jira jedhu; deeggartoonni garuu biyya tasgabbeessuu isaatiin deeggaran.
translated_content: Ugandan singer and MP Bobi Wine (Robert Kyagulanyi) and other opposition parliamentarians have been injured in attacks involving bombs and gunfire. Mr. Kyagulanyi, widely known as Bobi Wine, attracted significant attention after opposing a government-backed attempt to remove the presidential age limit. According to Mr. Kyagulanyi and MP Allan Ssewanyana, their homes were shot at on Tuesday morning. A government spokesperson denied the administration’s involvement in the shooting. "The shootings at the parliament members' residences might have been orchestrated covertly to discredit government structures," government spokesperson Opondo told the New Vision newspaper. Bobi Wine linked the daily threats and violence to protests over lifting the presidential age limit. "No one has been held accountable. But what kind of country are we living in?" he wrote on Facebook. Ssewanyana also posted on Facebook that his house was attacked on Tuesday morning. Last week, explosives were thrown at the property of opposition MP Moses Kasibante. Kasibante has been at the forefront of protests against the bill to remove the presidential age limit. The bill, which aims to scrap the age cap of 75, would allow President Yoweri Museveni to run again in the 2021 election. Last week, a commotion broke out in parliament during debates on the bill. Museveni, aged 73, has been in power since 1986. Critics accuse him of clinging to power, while his supporters credit him with stabilizing the country.
